title: TIM image metadata
description: <image>_meta.yaml: what the PNG of a TIM image leaves out, written by dwx extract (image_extractors.cpp: addTimImage). The PNG is the asset without the _meta suffix. A TIM that cannot be encoded gets neither file; the coverage report says why.

source.description: Path of the file on the disc.

entry.description: Index of the TIM in a file that packs several.

offset.description: Byte offset of the TIM in the source file.

image_rect.description: Where the pixels go in VRAM, in 16-bit VRAM units.

clut_rect.description: Where the palettes go in VRAM; only for indexed TIMs.

png.description: indexed: the PNG keeps the indices and palette 0; rgba: the colours.

png_palette.description: The palette the indexed PNG carries.

palettes.description: Every palette of the CLUT as 15-bit colours in hex, first to last.
